theorem compact_error_bound (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 4 f) (R ε : ℝ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x y : ℝ, |x| ≤ R → |y| ≤ R → |y - x| < δ →
      |simpson (deriv f) x y - (f y - f x)| ≤ ε * |y - x|^4

theorem sums_tendstoInMeasure (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 3 g)
    {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) :
    TendstoInMeasure jointMeasure (sums g T) atTop (lineIntegral g T)

theorem maximum_tendstoInMeasure (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 3 g)
    {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) :
    TendstoInMeasure jointMeasure (maximum g T) atTop (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))

theorem stopped_sums_tendstoInMeasure (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 3 g)
    {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) (τ : JointSample → ℝ≥0) (hτ : Measurable τ)
    (hτT : ∀ ω, τ ω ≤ T) :
    TendstoInMeasure jointMeasure
      (fun n ω => prefixSums g T n (index T n (τ ω)) ω) atTop
      (fun ω => lineIntegral g (τ ω) ω)

theorem compact_error_bound (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ t, ContDiff ℝ 4 (F t))
    (hD : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv 4 (F p.1) p.2))
    (T R ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ t ∈ Icc 0 T, ∀ x y : ℝ,
      |x| ≤ R → |y| ≤ R → |y - x| < δ →
      |IBMSimpsonPeano.simpson (deriv (F t)) x y - (F t y-F t x)| ≤ ε * |y - x|^4

theorem increments_tendsto (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (j : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hF : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t => F t x))
    (hD : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => timeDerivative F p.1 p.2))
    (hj : Continuous j) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) :
    Tendsto (fun n => increments F j T (n + 1)) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..T, timeDerivative F t (j t)))

theorem sums_tendstoInMeasure (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hspace : ∀ t, ContDiff ℝ 4 (F t))
    (htime : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t => F t x))
    (hfour : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv 4 (F p.1) p.2))
    (hdt : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => timeDerivative F p.1 p.2))
    {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) :
    TendstoInMeasure jointMeasure (sums F T) atTop
      (fun ω => F T (ibmValue T ω) - F 0 (ibmValue 0 ω) -
        ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..(T : ℝ), timeDerivative F t (path ω t))

theorem maximum_tendstoInMeasure (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hspace : ∀ t, ContDiff ℝ 4 (F t))
    (htime : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t => F t x))
    (hfour : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv 4 (F p.1) p.2))
    (hdt : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => timeDerivative F p.1 p.2))
    {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) :
    TendstoInMeasure jointMeasure (maximum F T) atTop (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))

theorem weighted_tendstoInMeasure (h g : ℝ → ℝ) (hh : ContDiff ℝ 1 h)
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ 3 g) {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) :
    TendstoInMeasure jointMeasure (weighted h g T) atTop (target h g T)

theorem approximation_error_bound (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hF : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2))
    (hD : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => timeDerivative F p.1 p.2))
    (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) (ω : JointSample) :
    ‖approximation F T n ω - bernsteinApproximation (n + 1) (curve F hF hD T ω)‖ ≤
      maximum F T n ω

theorem approximation_tendstoInMeasure (F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ)
    (hF : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p.1 p.2))
    (hspace : ∀ t, ContDiff ℝ 4 (F t))
    (htime : ∀ x, ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun t => F t x))
    (hfour : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iteratedDeriv 4 (F p.1) p.2))
    (hdt : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => timeDerivative F p.1 p.2))
    {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) :
    TendstoInMeasure jointMeasure (approximation F T) atTop (curve F hF hdt T)

theorem quartic_inner (h k : CoefficientSpace) :
    inner ℝ (quartic h) (quartic k) =
      9 * (‖h‖^2)^2 * (‖k‖^2)^2 +
      72 * (‖h‖^2) * (‖k‖^2) * (inner ℝ h k)^2 +
      24 * (inner ℝ h k)^4

theorem firstChaos_fourth_product (h k : CoefficientSpace) :
    (∫ ω, (firstChaosEmbedding h ω)^4 * (firstChaosEmbedding k ω)^4
      ∂gaussianProduct) =
      9 * (‖h‖^2)^2 * (‖k‖^2)^2 +
      72 * (‖h‖^2) * (‖k‖^2) * (inner ℝ h k)^2 +
      24 * (inner ℝ h k)^4

theorem conditional_fourth_centered_product
    (hmodS : ∀ r, S r =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] sceneryBase r)
    (s t u v : ℝ≥0) (ωY : SampleSpace) :
    (∫ ωX, fourthPower S C hS hC s t ωY ωX *
      fourthPower S C hS hC u v ωY ωX ∂gaussianProduct) -
      (∫ ωX, fourthPower S C hS hC s t ωY ωX ∂gaussianProduct) *
      (∫ ωX, fourthPower S C hS hC u v ωY ωX ∂gaussianProduct) =
      72 * abs (|C t ωY| - |C s ωY|) *
        abs (|C v ωY| - |C u ωY|) *
        (signedOverlap |C s ωY| |C t ωY| |C u ωY| |C v ωY|)^2 +
      24 * (signedOverlap |C s ωY| |C t ωY| |C u ωY| |C v ωY|)^4

theorem conditional_fourth_memLp_two
    (hmodS : ∀ r, S r =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] sceneryBase r)
    (s t : ℝ≥0) (ωY : SampleSpace) :
    MemLp (fourthPower S C hS hC s t ωY) 2 gaussianProduct

theorem conditional_quarticSum_second_moment_expand
    (hmodS : ∀ r, S r =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] sceneryBase r)
    (I : Finset (ℝ≥0 × ℝ≥0)) (ωY : SampleSpace) :
    (∫ ωX, (quarticSum S C hS hC I ωX ωY)^2 ∂gaussianProduct) =
      ∑ p ∈ I, ∑ q ∈ I,
        ∫ ωX, fourthPower S C hS hC p.1 p.2 ωY ωX *
          fourthPower S C hS hC q.1 q.2 ωY ωX ∂gaussianProduct

theorem abs_overlap (a b c d : ℝ) :
    |signedOverlap a b c d| =
      max (min (max a b) (max c d) - max (min a b) (min c d)) 0

theorem count_square_mass {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (a b : ι → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, count I a b x ^ 2) =
      ∑ i ∈ I, ∑ j ∈ I, |signedOverlap (a i) (b i) (a j) (b j)|

theorem quartic_covariance_le (a b c d δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hab : |b - a| ≤ δ) (hcd : |d - c| ≤ δ) :
    72 * |b-a| * |d-c| * signedOverlap a b c d ^ 2 +
      24 * signedOverlap a b c d ^ 4 ≤ 96 * δ ^ 3 * |signedOverlap a b c d|

theorem actual_conditional_centered_square_le
    (I : Finset (ℝ≥0 × ℝ≥0)) (ωY : SampleSpace) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hmesh : ∀ p ∈ I, abs (|IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ωY p.2| -
      |IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ωY p.1|) ≤ δ) :
    (∫ ωX, (quarticSum (fun r ω => IBMConstructedSources.sceneryPath ω r)
      (fun t ω => IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ω t)
      (fun ω => (IBMConstructedSources.sceneryPath ω).continuous)
      (fun ω => (IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ω).continuous) I ωX ωY -
      ∫ η, quarticSum (fun r ω => IBMConstructedSources.sceneryPath ω r)
        (fun t ω => IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ω t)
        (fun ω => (IBMConstructedSources.sceneryPath ω).continuous)
        (fun ω => (IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ω).continuous) I η ωY ∂gaussianProduct) ^ 2
      ∂gaussianProduct) ≤ 96 * δ ^ 3 * ∫ x,
        count I (fun p => |IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ωY p.1|)
          (fun p => |IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ωY p.2|) x ^ 2

theorem overlap_le_tent {a b c d δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)
    (hab : |b - a| ≤ δ) (hcd : |d - c| ≤ δ) :
    |signedOverlap a b c d| ≤ tent δ (a - c)
theorem tent_mass_le {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) : (∫ x, tent δ x) ≤ 8 * δ ^ 2

theorem folded_tent_average_le {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (r a : ℝ)
    {v : ℝ≥0} (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    (∫ x, tent δ (r - |x|) ∂gaussianReal a v) ≤ 16 * δ ^ 2 * peak v

theorem actual_clock_pair_bound {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (s t : ℝ≥0) :
    (∫ ω, tent δ (|IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ω s| -
      |IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ω t|) ∂gaussianProduct) ≤ pairBound δ s t

theorem energy_integrable {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (τ : ι → ℝ≥0)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) : Integrable (energy I τ δ) gaussianProduct

theorem energy_mean_le {ι : Type*} (I : Finset ι) (τ : ι → ℝ≥0)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) :
    (∫ ω, energy I τ δ ω ∂gaussianProduct) ≤ ∑ i ∈ I, ∑ j ∈ I, pairBound δ (τ i) (τ j)

theorem inverse_sqrt_sum (n : ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, 1 / Real.sqrt (i + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt (n : ℝ)

theorem actual_horizon_energy_mean_le {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (∫ ω, energy (Finset.range n) (grid (T / n)) δ ω ∂gaussianProduct) ≤
      2 * δ * n + 64 * δ ^ 2 * peak T * (n : ℝ) ^ 2

theorem actual_weighted_energy_mean_le {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (∫ ω, δ ^ 3 * energy (Finset.range n) (grid (T / n)) δ ω ∂gaussianProduct) ≤
      2 * n * δ ^ 4 + 64 * peak T * (n : ℝ) ^ 2 * δ ^ 5

theorem actual_weighted_energy_tendsto {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ ω,
      ((n + 1 : ℝ) ^ (-(4/9 : ℝ))) ^ 3 *
        energy (Finset.range (n + 1)) (grid (T / (n + 1)))
          ((n + 1 : ℝ) ^ (-(4/9 : ℝ))) ω ∂gaussianProduct)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

theorem actual_increment_tail (s t : ℝ≥0) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    gaussianProduct.real {ω | δ ≤ |IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ω t -
      IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ω s|} ≤
      |(t : ℝ) - s| ^ 10 * standardMoment 20 / δ ^ 20

theorem bad_probability_le (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    gaussianProduct.real (bad T n δ) ≤
      (n : ℝ) * ((T : ℝ) / n) ^ 10 * standardMoment 20 / δ ^ 20

theorem reflected_mesh_of_not_bad (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) (δ : ℝ) {ω : SampleSpace}
    (hω : ω ∉ bad T n δ) (k : Fin n) :
    abs (|IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ω (grid (T / n) (k.val + 1))| -
      |IBMConstructedSources.clockPath ω (grid (T / n) k.val)|) ≤ δ

theorem bad_probability_tendsto (T : ℝ≥0) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      gaussianProduct.real (bad T (n + 1) ((n + 1 : ℝ) ^ (-(4/9 : ℝ)))))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

theorem conditional_mean {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (y : SampleSpace) :
    (∫ x, quartic T n (x,y) ∂gaussianProduct) = clockMean T n y

theorem conditional_quartic_memLp {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (y : SampleSpace) : MemLp (fun x => quartic T n (x,y)) 2 gaussianProduct

theorem conditional_residual_square_integrable {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (y : SampleSpace) :
    Integrable (fun x => residual T n (x,y) ^ 2) gaussianProduct

theorem conditional_residual_square_le {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) {y : SampleSpace}
    (hy : y ∉ bad T n δ) :
    (∫ x, residual T n (x,y) ^ 2 ∂gaussianProduct) ≤
      96 * δ ^ 3 * energy (Finset.range n) (grid (T / n)) δ y

theorem joint_tail_eq_integral (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ) :
    jointMeasure.real (tailEvent T n ε) =
      ∫ y, conditionalTail T n ε y ∂gaussianProduct

theorem joint_tail_le {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    jointMeasure.real (tailEvent T n ε) ≤ gaussianProduct.real (bad T n δ) +
      (96 / ε ^ 2) * (∫ y, δ ^ 3 * energy (Finset.range n) (grid (T / n)) δ y
        ∂gaussianProduct)

theorem residual_tendstoInMeasure {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) :
    TendstoInMeasure jointMeasure (fun n : ℕ => residual T (n + 1))
      Filter.atTop (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))

theorem reflected_increment_sq (x y : ℝ) :
    (|y| - |x|)^2 = (y - x)^2 - crossingPenalty x y

theorem crossingPenalty_bounds (x y : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ crossingPenalty x y ∧ crossingPenalty x y ≤ (y - x)^2

theorem crossingPenalty_eq_zero_of_nonneg {x y : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ x * y) :
    crossingPenalty x y = 0

theorem crossingPenalty_eq_of_neg {x y : ℝ} (h : x * y < 0) :
    crossingPenalty x y = -4 * (x * y)

theorem penalty_le_tent {a b δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hinc : |b - a| ≤ δ) :
    crossingPenalty a b ≤ δ * tent δ a

theorem nearEnergy_mean_le {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (n : ℕ) :
    (∫ ω, nearEnergy T (n + 1) δ ω ∂gaussianProduct) ≤
      2 * δ ^ 2 + 32 * peak T * (n + 1 : ℝ) * δ ^ 3

theorem penalty_tail_le (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    gaussianProduct.real {ω | ε ≤ penalty T n ω} ≤ gaussianProduct.real (bad T n δ) +
      (∫ ω, nearEnergy T n δ ω ∂gaussianProduct) / ε

theorem penalty_tendstoInMeasure {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) :
    TendstoInMeasure gaussianProduct (fun n : ℕ => penalty T (n + 1))
      Filter.atTop (fun _ => (0 : ℝ))

theorem actual_clockSquare_tendstoInMeasure (T : ℝ≥0) :
    TendstoInMeasure gaussianProduct (fun n : ℕ => clockSquare T (n + 1))
      Filter.atTop (fun _ => (T : ℝ))

theorem clockMean_identity (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) (ω : SampleSpace) :
    clockMean T n ω = 3 * clockSquare T n ω - 3 * penalty T n ω

theorem clockMean_tendstoInMeasure {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) :
    TendstoInMeasure gaussianProduct (fun n : ℕ => clockMean T (n + 1))
      Filter.atTop (fun _ => 3 * (T : ℝ))

theorem quartic_tendstoInMeasure {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) :
    TendstoInMeasure jointMeasure (fun n : ℕ => quartic T (n + 1))
      Filter.atTop (fun _ => 3 * (T : ℝ))

theorem quartic_le (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) (ω : JointSample) :
    quartic T (n + 1) ω ≤ (mesh T n ω)^2 * quadratic T n ω

theorem first_identity (T : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) (ω : JointSample) :
    first T n ω + quadratic T n ω =
      (ibmValue T ω)^2 - (ibmValue 0 ω)^2

theorem quadratic_lower_tail {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) (K : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => jointMeasure.real {ω | quadratic T n ω ≤ K})
      atTop (𝓝 0)

theorem quadratic_no_finite_limit {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) (Y : JointSample → ℝ) :
    ¬TendstoInMeasure jointMeasure (quadratic T) atTop Y

theorem first_no_finite_limit {T : ℝ≥0} (hT : 0 < T) (Y : JointSample → ℝ) :
    ¬TendstoInMeasure jointMeasure (first T) atTop Y

theorem concentration_source_bound (h : ℝ≥0) (n : ℕ) (Y : SampleSpace)
    (h0 : clockCurve h Y 0 = 0) {M δ : ℝ} (hM : 0 ≤ M) (hδ : 0 ≤ δ)

proof_reorganization: Human proof uses the explicitly proved weaker direct Gaussian fourth-moment bound; no new named Lean proof of that shortcut is claimed. The full variation proof is now reconstructed separately, with exact Gaussian eighth moments, repeated-overlap occupation, triangular folded-Gaussian envelope, bounded-increment localization, reflected-crossing penalty and all uniform grids. The printed lower-tail consequence uses the same deterministic quartic/mesh inequality in a direct probability argument. No new formal declarations or almost-sure/weighted strengthening is claimed.

literature_comparison.review: Burdzy 1994: primary institutional indexed abstract and author publication record establish the classical quartic-variation antecedent; detailed original partition/model hypotheses were not fully accessible.

Primary Khoshnevisan--Lewis, Theorem 4.3: stronger weighted quartic variation on its induced random partition for two-sided scenery. Not an identification with this reflected-clock, deterministic physical-grid model.

human_reorganization: Section 10 uses N>=1 physical cells rather than source index N+1. Its R_N,C_N notation is local to that section: R_N is the actual left raw sum, C_N its random conditional scenery mean, S_N=R_N-C_N, and I_N=E[S_N|sigma(Z_t:t>=0)]. No changing-past projection, adapted representation, or projection/chaos commutation is assumed.

Folded clock quadratic variation is proved directly in L1 from crossing loss, independent increments, the one-time Gaussian density bound and fourth-moment tails, with the two successive limits N->infinity then delta->0. This is a human reorganization of the formal shrinking-width proof, not a new named rate theorem.

The spatial nonnegative rectangle kernel has folded quadratic-variation mass, squared interval Gram energy and support in a shrinking band. The conditional Wick telescope gives energy identity and the bound q_N^2<=4 M eta (conditional scenery energy+ordinary clock QV). A bounded-energy subsequence, L1/a.e. extraction, clock continuity and nonnegative Fatou contradict its bounded expected energy. This reorganizes the formal truncated dominated-convergence proof.

Discrete Tanaka crossing control and centered ordinary absolute increments give Var(C_N)<=9T/2 without an uncentered variation bound. Testing I_N against the observable R_N-E C_N gives exact a_N pairing and a_N^2<=||I_N||^2(a_N+Var C_N). Hence the projected original native output has diverging L2 norm. No probability divergence, rate, exclusion of all renormalizations, or completed physical-time Ito calculus is asserted.

The source finite field has scenery component sum X(h_i)d_i and zero clock component. Fiberwise Gaussian adjointness and original observable restriction give the displayed test identity and the exact formal native-value projection. The independently printed actual conditional-expectation theorem requires no enlarged native domain.

The non-Gaussian marginal fourth-moment comparison is an elementary actual-law deduction used only to delimit Gaussian-process Wick-Riemann antecedents. Primary Liu introduction and Hypothesis 1.1 and Khoshnevisan-Lewis process/partition conventions were inspected; priority for this exact projected escape remains unresolved.

Section 10.4 upgrades the already proved original projected native norm escape to its named full-observable weak obstruction. The complete Baire closed-set proof reconstructs Banach--Steinhaus for Riesz pairing functionals: pointwise boundedness would imply a common norm bound. Thus a single intrinsic observable has unbounded pairings on the full grid sequence, and every prescribed strictly increasing subsequence separately admits a detecting observable, excluding weak convergence. No one test for all subsequences is claimed. The detector is only in the full observable L2 space; no original derivative-domain membership, smoothness or boundedness follows, so smaller graph-dual convergence and different prescriptions remain open. The spatial Simpson results are unchanged.
